inclusion.rationale: Metformin trials target adult T2DM. Below 30 = pediatric (different dosing); above 70 = increased adverse risk.
inclusion.table_column: PATIENTS.DOB → compute age at admission date

inclusion.rationale: Core inclusion: ICD-9 250.x0/250.x2 = Type 2. Must NOT be Type 1 (250.x1/250.x3).
HbA1c is 3-month average blood sugar. ≥ 7.5% = poor control → qualifies for intervention.
Confirms active hyperglycemia at time of trial. Secondary confirmatory criterion.
Metformin specifically benefits overweight T2DM patients — weight neutral, may reduce weight.
Metformin cleared by kidneys. Low eGFR → drug accumulates → lactic acidosis risk.
Direct creatinine threshold used in original Metformin prescribing guidelines (FDA label).
Severe HTN indicates poor cardiovascular control — increases trial complexity.

inclusion.description: No insulin therapy for > 3 months prior to enrollment
inclusion.rationale: Trial targets patients manageable with oral agents. Long-term insulin = more severe disease.

inclusion.description: Willing and able to provide written informed consent
inclusion.rationale: Ethical requirement. Patient must be cognitively capable and consent voluntarily.

inclusion.description: Ability to understand and follow dietary instructions
inclusion.rationale: Metformin works best with lifestyle modification. Patient must be capable of compliance.
inclusion.table_column: NOTEEVENTS → NER for 'dietary counseling', 'diabetic diet', 'meal plan'

inclusion.description: English language proficiency OR translator available
inclusion.rationale: Patient must understand trial procedures. Protocol documents in English.

inclusion.description: ALT / AST < 3× Upper Limit of Normal (liver function adequate)
inclusion.rationale: Metformin metabolized in liver. Elevated liver enzymes = possible liver damage risk.

inclusion.description: No hospitalization for diabetes-related illness in past 6 months
inclusion.rationale: Recent DKA/hyperosmolar coma = unstable diabetes — not suitable for oral agent trial.
inclusion.table_column: ADMISSIONS.DIAGNOSIS contains 'diabetic ketoacidosis' OR ICD9 250.1x → date check

inclusion.description: Stable weight (< 5% change in past 3 months)
inclusion.rationale: Significant weight change indicates uncontrolled metabolic state or malnutrition.
inclusion.table_column: CHARTEVENTS ITEMID=3580 (Weight) → compare values over 3-month window

exclusion.description: Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (insulin-dependent)
exclusion.rationale: T1DM has autoimmune destruction of beta cells — Metformin ineffective. Different pathophysiology.

exclusion.description: Severe renal impairment: eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73m²
exclusion.rationale: FDA Black Box Warning: Metformin contraindicated in severe renal failure — fatal lactic acidosis.

exclusion.description: Congestive Heart Failure requiring pharmacologic treatment
exclusion.rationale: CHF causes hypoperfusion of organs → lactic acid buildup → Metformin worsens lactic acidosis.

exclusion.description: Active or chronic liver disease (Cirrhosis / Hepatitis)
exclusion.rationale: Liver clears lactate. Diseased liver cannot clear → lactic acidosis risk is extreme.

exclusion.description: Chronic alcohol abuse (≥ 3 drinks/day)
exclusion.rationale: Alcohol inhibits gluconeogenesis and impairs lactate clearance — synergistic toxicity with Metformin.

exclusion.description: Current or planned pregnancy (women of childbearing age)
exclusion.rationale: Metformin crosses placenta. Category B but trial protocol excludes pregnant women.

exclusion.description: Known hypersensitivity / allergy to Metformin or biguanides
exclusion.rationale: Documented allergic reaction = absolute contraindication per trial protocol.
exclusion.table_column: PRESCRIPTIONS → allergy list + NOTEEVENTS → 'Metformin allergy', 'biguanide sensitivity'

exclusion.description: Radiologic contrast dye procedure within past 48 hours
exclusion.rationale: IV contrast temporarily impairs kidneys → Metformin must be withheld 48h before and after.
exclusion.table_column: PRESCRIPTIONS DRUG LIKE '%contrast%' OR NOTEEVENTS → 'CT with contrast' → date check

exclusion.description: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA) or hyperosmolar state currently
exclusion.rationale: Acute DKA = emergency. Oral agents NOT appropriate — requires IV insulin immediately.

exclusion.description: Participation in another clinical trial within past 30 days
exclusion.rationale: Trial protocol integrity: concurrent trial participation causes confounding.
exclusion.table_column: NOTEEVENTS → NER 'clinical trial', 'study drug', 'research protocol' → date check

exclusion.description: Major surgery planned within 3 months of enrollment
exclusion.rationale: Surgery temporarily disrupts metabolism and renal perfusion — Metformin must be stopped pre-op.

exclusion.description: Severe respiratory disease causing hypoxemia (SpO2 < 90%)
exclusion.rationale: Hypoxia promotes anaerobic metabolism → lactic acid production → Metformin worsens acidosis.

exclusion.description: Patient refuses consent or is cognitively impaired
exclusion.rationale: Ethical: cannot enroll patient who cannot give voluntary informed consent.

inclusion.rationale: Warfarin dosing validated only in adults. Pediatric pharmacokinetics differ significantly.

inclusion.description: Confirmed Atrial Fibrillation (AF) — paroxysmal, persistent, or permanent
inclusion.rationale: Primary indication for Warfarin in this trial. AF causes blood clots → stroke risk.
Warfarin only justified when stroke risk exceeds bleeding risk. Score computed from comorbidities.
Patient must not already be anticoagulated at enrollment. INR > 1.5 = already on blood thinners.
Minimum platelet level needed to tolerate anticoagulation without catastrophic bleeding risk.
Severely uncontrolled hypertension increases hemorrhagic stroke risk on Warfarin.
Anticoagulation only benefits patients with sufficient survival time horizon.

inclusion.description: No history of intracranial hemorrhage (> 6 months ago)
inclusion.rationale: Prior brain bleed indicates blood vessel fragility — Warfarin risk may still be acceptable if old.
inclusion.table_column: DIAGNOSES_ICD 431.x (ICH) → date of admission > 6 months ago

inclusion.rationale: Severe anemia combined with anticoagulation creates extreme bleeding-related decompensation risk.

inclusion.description: Reliable access to INR monitoring facility
inclusion.rationale: Warfarin requires frequent INR blood tests (weekly initially). Must confirm patient can access lab.
inclusion.table_column: NOTEEVENTS → NER 'lives alone', 'rural', 'no transport' → negative check; or social work note

inclusion.description: Ability to comply with medication schedule and follow-up visits
inclusion.rationale: Warfarin has narrow therapeutic window — missed doses or monitoring visits are dangerous.
Cancer patients on chemo have unpredictable INR fluctuations — Warfarin interaction complex.
inclusion.table_column: DIAGNOSES_ICD 140.x–208.x (malignancy) + PRESCRIPTIONS chemo agents → active check

inclusion.rationale: Warfarin metabolites partially cleared by kidneys. Severe renal impairment alters drug levels.
inclusion.table_column: LABEVENTS ITEMID=50912 (Creatinine) → compute eGFR via CKD-EPI

inclusion.rationale: Mandatory ethical requirement for all trial participants.
inclusion.table_column: NOTEEVENTS → NER 'informed consent', 'consented to trial', 'agreed to participate'

exclusion.description: Active bleeding or hemorrhagic stroke within past 6 months
exclusion.rationale: ABSOLUTE contraindication. Warfarin will worsen active or recent bleed catastrophically.

exclusion.description: Platelet count < 50,000/μL (severe thrombocytopenia)
exclusion.rationale: Anticoagulation with critically low platelets = uncontrollable bleeding risk.

exclusion.description: Pregnancy (confirmed or suspected)
exclusion.rationale: Warfarin is TERATOGENIC — causes fetal warfarin syndrome and fetal hemorrhage.

exclusion.description: Known hypersensitivity to Warfarin or coumarin compounds
exclusion.rationale: Documented allergic reaction to Warfarin = absolute contraindication.
exclusion.table_column: PRESCRIPTIONS → allergy field; NOTEEVENTS → 'Warfarin allergy', 'coumarin allergy'

exclusion.description: Concurrent high-dose NSAID use (ibuprofen ≥ 1200 mg/day, naproxen, etc.)
exclusion.rationale: NSAIDs inhibit platelet aggregation AND increase GI mucosal bleeding risk — synergistic with Warfarin.
exclusion.table_column: PRESCRIPTIONS.DRUG LIKE '%ibuprofen%' OR '%naproxen%' → dose check ≥ 1200 mg

exclusion.description: Severe liver disease: Child-Pugh Class C cirrhosis
exclusion.rationale: Liver produces clotting factors. Severe cirrhosis already impairs coagulation — Warfarin unpredictable.

exclusion.description: Blood pressure > 180/110 mmHg uncontrolled
exclusion.rationale: Severely uncontrolled HTN + Warfarin = high risk of hemorrhagic stroke.

exclusion.description: Current or planned neurosurgery or ophthalmic surgery within 2 weeks
exclusion.rationale: Surgery near brain or eyes — Warfarin must be stopped. Cannot enroll mid-peri-operative period.
exclusion.table_column: NOTEEVENTS → NER 'craniotomy', 'cataract surgery', 'neurosurgical' → future date check

exclusion.description: Active peptic ulcer disease or GI bleed within 1 year
exclusion.rationale: GI ulcers bleed freely — Warfarin's anti-clotting effect causes uncontrollable GI hemorrhage.
exclusion.table_column: DIAGNOSES_ICD 531.x (gastric ulcer), 532.x (duodenal ulcer), 578.x (GI bleed) → date check

exclusion.description: Alcohol dependency or abuse (HbA1c-equivalent: chronic alcohol > 14 units/week)
exclusion.rationale: Alcohol unpredictably alters Warfarin metabolism — one week potentiates, next week inhibits.

exclusion.description: Planned use of drugs with major Warfarin interaction (amiodarone, fluconazole, rifampin)
exclusion.rationale: These drugs drastically alter Warfarin levels — INR becomes unpredictable and dangerous.

exclusion.description: Patient unwilling or unable to comply with INR monitoring
exclusion.rationale: Warfarin safety depends entirely on regular INR testing. Non-compliance = undetected over-anticoagulation.
exclusion.table_column: NOTEEVENTS → NER 'refuses blood tests', 'non-compliant', 'missed follow-up' pattern

NCT00000560.title: Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction (Lisinopril)

inclusion.rationale: SOLVD trial range. Under 21 = pediatric HF (different etiology); over 80 = too frail for ACE inhibitor.
inclusion.table_column: PATIENTS.DOB → compute age BETWEEN 21 AND 80 at enrollment

inclusion.rationale: Must have documented HF — primary eligibility. All sub-types: systolic, diastolic, combined.
Lisinopril proven ONLY for reduced EF heart failure (HFrEF). Not effective in preserved-EF (HFpEF).
inclusion.table_column: NOTEEVENTS → Bio_ClinicalBERT NER: 'ejection fraction <X%', 'EF=X%', 'LVEF X%' → X < 40

inclusion.description: NYHA Class II or III symptoms (moderate heart failure)
inclusion.rationale: NYHA II = slight activity limitation; NYHA III = marked limitation. ACE inhibitors best for these.
inclusion.table_column: NOTEEVENTS → NER: 'NYHA class II', 'NYHA class III', 'moderate heart failure', 'class 2/3'

inclusion.description: Systolic Blood Pressure ≥ 90 mmHg at baseline
inclusion.rationale: ACE inhibitors lower blood pressure. Starting in hypotensive patient → dangerous BP drop → shock.
inclusion.table_column: CHARTEVENTS.ITEMID=51 (SBP), VALUENUM ≥ 90 at time of enrollment

inclusion.rationale: ACE inhibitors retain potassium (block aldosterone). Must start with normal K+ to avoid hyperkalemia.

inclusion.description: Serum Creatinine < 2.5 mg/dL (mild-moderate renal impairment acceptable)
inclusion.rationale: Lisinopril can be used with mild-moderate CKD — actually protects kidneys in diabetics.
Severe hyponatremia in HF indicates advanced disease — ACE inhibitor may worsen fluid imbalance.

inclusion.description: Currently on stable diuretic therapy (Furosemide or equivalent)
inclusion.rationale: ACE inhibitor added on top of diuretic is standard HF treatment protocol (evidence-based combo).

inclusion.description: No other ACE inhibitor or ARB currently prescribed
inclusion.rationale: Cannot use two ACE inhibitors together — redundant and increases side effect risk.
inclusion.table_column: PRESCRIPTIONS.DRUG LIKE '%pril' OR '%sartan' → check NOT currently active

inclusion.description: Brain Natriuretic Peptide (BNP) ≥ 100 pg/mL OR NT-proBNP ≥ 300 pg/mL
inclusion.rationale: BNP is heart stress biomarker. Elevated confirms active heart failure justifying treatment.

inclusion.description: Ability to tolerate ACE inhibitor (no prior intolerance documented)
inclusion.rationale: Some patients develop ACE inhibitor cough or other intolerance — must confirm no prior issues.
inclusion.table_column: PRESCRIPTIONS history + NOTEEVENTS → NER 'cough from ACE', 'stopped lisinopril'

inclusion.rationale: Confirms patient has some exercise capacity — too frail = end-stage HF (NYHA IV, excluded).
inclusion.table_column: NOTEEVENTS → NER '6-minute walk', '6MWT', 'exercise tolerance' → extract distance value

inclusion.description: Written informed consent obtained prior to any study procedure
inclusion.rationale: Mandatory ethical and regulatory requirement for all clinical trial participants.
inclusion.table_column: NOTEEVENTS → NER 'informed consent', 'consented', 'agreed to participate in study'

exclusion.description: Prior ACE inhibitor-induced angioedema (any ACE inhibitor)
exclusion.rationale: Angioedema = life-threatening throat swelling. CLASS contraindication — even different ACE inhibitor.
exclusion.table_column: NOTEEVENTS → NER 'angioedema', 'lip swelling', 'throat swelling' + PRESCRIPTIONS ACE inhibitors

exclusion.description: Serum Creatinine > 3.0 mg/dL (severe renal impairment)
exclusion.rationale: ACE inhibitors reduce renal perfusion in diseased kidneys — acute kidney failure risk.

exclusion.description: Serum Potassium > 5.5 mEq/L (hyperkalemia at baseline)
exclusion.rationale: ACE inhibitors INCREASE potassium. Starting with high K+ → fatal cardiac arrhythmia.

exclusion.description: Systolic Blood Pressure < 90 mmHg (hypotension) at enrollment
exclusion.rationale: ACE inhibitor will further drop BP → cardiogenic shock → death.

exclusion.description: Bilateral renal artery stenosis (confirmed or suspected)
exclusion.rationale: ACE inhibitor blocks compensatory angiotensin II → bilateral RAS = acute renal failure.
exclusion.table_column: DIAGNOSES_ICD 440.1 (renal artery stenosis) OR NOTEEVENTS → 'bilateral RAS', 'renal artery'

exclusion.description: Pregnancy or breastfeeding
exclusion.rationale: ACE inhibitors are TERATOGENIC (Category D) — fetal renal agenesis and death reported.

exclusion.description: NYHA Class IV Heart Failure (end-stage, symptoms at rest)
exclusion.rationale: End-stage HF patients are too hemodynamically unstable. ACE inhibitor initiation requires stability.
exclusion.table_column: NOTEEVENTS → NER 'NYHA class IV', 'symptoms at rest', 'NYHA 4', 'end-stage heart failure'

exclusion.description: Aortic stenosis (severe valvular obstruction)
exclusion.rationale: ACE inhibitor vasodilation in severe aortic stenosis → precipitous BP drop → syncope/death.
exclusion.table_column: DIAGNOSES_ICD 424.1 (aortic stenosis) OR NOTEEVENTS → 'severe AS', 'critical aortic stenosis'

exclusion.description: Hypertrophic Obstructive Cardiomyopathy (HOCM)
exclusion.rationale: HOCM with fixed outflow obstruction — vasodilation worsens obstruction and causes syncope.

exclusion.description: Recent Myocardial Infarction < 4 weeks ago
exclusion.rationale: Acute MI phase — hemodynamic instability. ACE inhibitor initiation deferred until stable (4-week window).

exclusion.description: Currently on dual RAAS blockade (ACE inhibitor + ARB + Aldosterone antagonist)
exclusion.rationale: Triple RAAS blockade causes severe hyperkalemia and renal failure — protocol excludes this combination.
exclusion.table_column: PRESCRIPTIONS → check for active ACE inhibitor AND ARB AND aldosterone antagonist simultaneously

exclusion.description: Active malignancy with expected survival < 1 year
exclusion.rationale: Terminal cancer: benefit of long-term HF therapy does not outweigh trial burden for patient.
exclusion.table_column: DIAGNOSES_ICD 140.x-208.x (malignancy) + NOTEEVENTS → prognosis notes → survival estimate

exclusion.description: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) requiring frequent hospitalizations
exclusion.rationale: Severe COPD causes cor pulmonale (right HF) — a different HF etiology not addressed by this trial.
